experiments.title: HoloDeck deterministic digital twin
experiments.hypothesis: Hardware behavior can be rehearsed without touching a live NAS.
experiments.value: Makes risky reliability work repeatable and safe.

outcome.conclusion: The twin provides the safe execution substrate for later experiments.

revisit_conditions: new hardware provider or invariant class
experiments.strongest_follow_up: Keep every actionable recovery path attached to a deterministic mission.

experiments.title: Black Box privacy-safe record and replay
experiments.hypothesis: Bounded sanitized telemetry can preserve incident context without retaining secrets.
experiments.value: Turns one incident into reusable evidence.

outcome.conclusion: Sanitized recordings are portable regression inputs.

revisit_conditions: recording schema changes
experiments.strongest_follow_up: Grow a separately governed field corpus.

experiments.title: ORACLE slow-degradation detection
experiments.hypothesis: Baseline-relative trends identify degradation before fixed thresholds.
experiments.value: Creates useful warning lead without control authority.

outcome.conclusion: ORACLE supplies early trend evidence but remains subordinate to verified hard faults.

invalidated_assumptions: a statistical anomaly alone is actionable
revisit_conditions: field corpus becomes representative
experiments.strongest_follow_up: Calibrate trend confidence on opt-in evidence.

experiments.title: Lifeline hardware identity
experiments.hypothesis: Recovery guidance is safe only when physical and logical identities agree.

outcome.conclusion: Lifeline converts hardware identity into an explicit safety gate.

invalidated_assumptions: Linux device names are durable identity
revisit_conditions: new enclosure mapping source
experiments.strongest_follow_up: Attach identity confidence to every Flight Director plan.

experiments.title: Pathfinder recovery contracts
experiments.hypothesis: Guidance can be expressed as an advisory state machine with machine-verifiable completion.

outcome.conclusion: Recovery state and evidence can be composed while control authority remains false.

revisit_conditions: new actionable guidance code
experiments.strongest_follow_up: Add repair signatures that compare observed recovery to rehearsal.

experiments.title: Stargate guarded hardware research
experiments.hypothesis: Undocumented hardware can be characterized behind explicit interlocks and evidence capture.
experiments.value: Expands platform knowledge without casual live experimentation.

outcome.conclusion: Stargate provides an auditable boundary for future hardware discovery.

revisit_conditions: new platform or protocol
experiments.strongest_follow_up: Feed repeatable discoveries into HoloDeck fixtures.

experiments.title: AEGIS shared-cause reliability engineer
experiments.hypothesis: Independent cooling and thermal signals can form one evidence-backed incident earlier than isolated alerts.
experiments.value: Reduces alert noise while improving operator lead time.
success_criteria: no false positives in challenge fixtures
abort_criteria: one signal treated as root cause

outcome.conclusion: Declarative grouping identifies shared cooling 27 samples early and preserves raw evidence.

invalidated_assumptions: two unusual thermal values prove shared cooling
revisit_conditions: real field labels become available
experiments.strongest_follow_up: Add topology, forecast, rehearsals, and repair signatures.

experiments.title: Governed field evidence workflow
experiments.hypothesis: Operator-consented evidence can be sanitized, reviewed, frozen, and assessed without retaining identity.
experiments.value: Creates a safe path from lab calibration toward field knowledge.

outcome.conclusion: The installed package completes the governed workflow and correctly remains lab calibrated.

invalidated_assumptions: zero observed false positives implies field readiness
revisit_conditions: operator-consented field recordings exist
experiments.strongest_follow_up: Collect diverse normal workloads and reviewed incidents.

experiments.title: Signal-count shared-cause heuristic
experiments.hypothesis: Any two unusual cooling-related metrics are enough to claim one cooling cause.
experiments.value: Would have offered a very small correlation implementation.
protocol: run positive and adversarial warming fixtures
abort_criteria: thermal-only evidence produces a cooling fault

outcome.failure_mode: The heuristic misclassified two of three adversarial negatives.
outcome.reusable_lesson: Require independent evidence groups and explicit confidence caps.

invalidated_assumptions: signal count is equivalent to causal independence
revisit_conditions: never without causal evidence groups

experiments.title: Automatic production promotion from perfect fixture scores
experiments.hypothesis: A perfect small synthetic corpus can authorize production validation.
protocol: compute uncertainty bounds around observed fixture performance

outcome.failure_mode: Wilson bounds showed the small sample cannot support field claims.
outcome.reusable_lesson: Separate observed score, uncertainty, field candidacy, and human release review.

invalidated_assumptions: perfect point estimate proves reliability
revisit_conditions: never as an automatic production gate

experiments.title: Opt-in real workload corpus
experiments.hypothesis: Diverse sanitized normal workloads and reviewed incidents will narrow uncertainty without retaining operator identity.
experiments.value: Tests whether AEGIS is useful outside deterministic fixtures.
revisit_conditions: JT initiates a consented intake session
experiments.strongest_follow_up: Define a small reviewed collection campaign.

experiments.title: Replaceable online detector benchmark
experiments.hypothesis: A River-backed detector may improve nonlinear drift detection when benchmarked behind the existing detector interface.
experiments.value: Could improve calibration without coupling Mission Control to one algorithm.
success_criteria: better bounded accuracy with acceptable dependency weight
revisit_conditions: representative corpus reaches diversity floor
experiments.strongest_follow_up: Benchmark through IncidentDetector; do not replace policy by intuition.

experiments.title: Flight Director shared-cooling vertical slice
experiments.hypothesis: A replay, causal map, bounded forecast, what-if rehearsal, and recovery signature make one incident clearer and safer than isolated thresholds.
experiments.value: Turns AEGIS evidence into an operator-ready Now/Next/Why/Proof flight plan.
abort_criteria: synthetic evidence presented as field validation

outcome.conclusion: The slice identifies one shared cause 27 samples early, forecasts the fixture crossing with zero-sample error, reduces two alerts to one incident, and verifies restored airflow while labeling all missing identities unknown.

invalidated_assumptions: aggregate telemetry can identify a physical fan channel or bay
zero fixture error implies field precision
reproduction: python -c "from truepanel.aegis.flight_director import run_flight_director_proof as run; print(run()['measurements'])"
revisit_conditions: field topology or recovery evidence becomes available
experiments.strongest_follow_up: Bind passive enclosure topology and real recovery observations through Lifeline.

experiments.title: GLASS COCKPIT evidence-led Mission Control
experiments.hypothesis: A calm incident-first command strip and causal-domain grouping will reduce structural interaction cost without weakening phone usability or hiding safety state.
experiments.value: Makes the working reliability system faster to orient, legible, and durable without a framework rewrite.
protocol: audit accepted DOM and shared stream
render three candidates with one deterministic incident
exercise eight tasks at eight widths
success_criteria: no horizontal overflow from 320 through 1920 CSS pixels
active incident action and proof never hidden

outcome.conclusion: Candidate B consolidated eleven competing surfaces into four decision domains with eight above-fold task facts and a structural interaction cost of 8; the denser candidate was rejected despite one lower cost unit because it added 75% more visual competition.

invalidated_assumptions: an aviation look requires aviation density
every sensor benefits from a full graph
secondary details and active safety state can share one drawer
revisit_conditions: human task testing contradicts the structural result
new Mission Control decision domain is added
experiments.strongest_follow_up: Run moderated think-aloud tests with one new and one experienced operator on lab fixtures, then tune only measured friction.

experiments.title: CHECKRIDE live storage recovery
experiments.hypothesis: A verified SMART incident can be composed into an identity-bound advisory flight plan and later closed by a machine-verifiable repair signature.
experiments.value: Turns a deceptive PASSED/ONLINE drive failure into safe, personalized guidance while preserving the first governed real repair lesson.

development.next_test: Reconfirm backup, bay, serial, pool, VDEV, and replacement fit immediately before external service.
development.exit_criteria: Capture an evidence-backed passing or failing repair-verification signature after an externally performed replacement.

outcome.status: Software composition and six hardware-isolated branches are proven; external repair and field verification remain open.

invalidated_assumptions: conversation history is equivalent to machine-verifiable backup evidence
SMART PASSED plus ZFS ONLINE means a drive is healthy
revisit_conditions: a compatible replacement drive is available
backup and identity can be freshly reconfirmed
experiments.strongest_follow_up: Acquire a compatible replacement, then capture the real repair through the same rehearsed verification contract.

experiments.title: CHECKRIDE pre-service clearance receipts
experiments.hypothesis: Fresh identity, redundancy, backup-restore, procedure, candidate-fit, and recovery-state evidence can be reconciled into one expiring advisory receipt without granting repair authority.
experiments.value: Prevents a collection of individually plausible facts from being mistaken for a safe service decision.
success_criteria: 6/6 gates pass only on mutually consistent fresh evidence
physical and storage-write authority remain false
abort_criteria: operator acknowledgement treated as restore proof
device path treated as durable identity

outcome.conclusion: The deterministic positive fixture passes all six gates and produces a digest-bound 15-minute receipt, while absent or stale backup/candidate evidence fails closed and both physical-service and storage-write authority remain false.

invalidated_assumptions: a backup checkbox proves recoverability
nominal candidate capacity is sufficient service evidence
a READY label may persist without expiry
revisit_conditions: a governed live backup evidence provider exists
a real replacement candidate is passively observed
service-time evidence needs a different expiry policy
experiments.strongest_follow_up: Bind a governed backup/restore attestation provider and passively discovered replacement candidate to the live incident, then capture the external repair signature.

experiments.title: AEGIS recovery ground-truth attestations
experiments.hypothesis: Incident-bound, fresh, digest-intact provider statements can prevent plausible but stale, ambiguous, or weakly identified recovery facts from producing a review-ready clearance.
experiments.value: Turns recovery evidence from loose payload fields into a replaceable, auditable trust boundary without granting control authority.
protocol: validate provider, freshness, semantics, and digest
exercise one valid and six unsafe HoloDeck paths
success_criteria: no digest is presented as provider authentication
abort_criteria: weak serial suffix treated as strong identity

outcome.conclusion: The deterministic valid path accepts two provider statements, while mutated, expired, identity-reused, ungoverned, missing, and ambiguous evidence produces 6/6 HOLD decisions with zero unsafe false-ready outcomes.

invalidated_assumptions: a SHA-256 digest authenticates its provider
a masked serial suffix is sufficient replacement identity
multiple valid statements may be selected implicitly
a repository check alone proves restorability
reproduction: python -c "from truepanel.holodeck.aegis_attestations import run_recovery_attestation_rehearsal as run; print(run()['measurements'])"
revisit_conditions: supported passive TrueNAS backup or block-inventory provider is available
local provider-authentication trust root is defined
real replacement candidate can be observed without actuation
experiments.strongest_follow_up: Implement supported passive local backup and replacement-inventory adapters, then compare their statements with the HoloDeck contract before lifting the live CHECKRIDE evidence HOLD.

experiments.title: Passive TrueNAS recovery evidence providers
experiments.hypothesis: Documented read-only TrueNAS task and disk queries can strengthen recovery evidence without confusing backup completion with restore verification or granting mutation authority.
experiments.value: Connects AEGIS ground truth to replaceable platform adapters while preserving conservative CHECKRIDE holds.
protocol: cross-check disk identity and pool state
success_criteria: successful task is not promoted without restore proof
abort_criteria: disk.query used as sole preserved-data proof
backup SUCCESS treated as restore proof
provider enabled live without cadence and role review

outcome.conclusion: The positive fixture accepts both ground-truth statements; successful-task-only, pooled-candidate, and identity-mismatch paths produce 3/3 HOLD decisions with zero unsafe false-ready outcomes and no mutating method.

invalidated_assumptions: successful replication proves recoverability
pool absence proves blank media
a Linux path is sufficient disk identity
read-only integration requires a cloud dependency
reproduction: python -c "from truepanel.holodeck.aegis_passive_providers import run_passive_provider_rehearsal as run; print(run()['measurements'])"
revisit_conditions: least-privilege TrueNAS query role is reviewed
bounded provider cadence is defined
governed restore receipt directory exists
passive BattleStation observation is authorized
experiments.strongest_follow_up: Add a bounded cached runtime with explicit read-only TrueNAS role verification and a governed local receipt store, then perform a passive no-deploy BattleStation observation.

experiments.title: Governed passive evidence runtime
experiments.hypothesis: A bounded cache, explicit session-role gate, and ownership-governed read-only receipt store can make passive TrueNAS evidence safe to activate without allowing stale or over-privileged observations to clear recovery.
experiments.value: Converts the provider prototype into a measurable activation boundary while preventing status-stream polling amplification and ambient root authority.
protocol: authenticate through TLS-verified credential-safe WebSocket transport
confirm the live session role set before protection queries
capture a sanitized no-deploy field observation
perform a controlled native TrueNAS backup and restore round trip
independently verify backup and restored objects by SHA-256
issue an incident-bound governed restore receipt
success_criteria: first observation uses at most three middleware calls
runtime writes and mutating calls remain zero
field session verifies required read-only roles before protection queries
sanitized field observation holds when tested-restore proof is absent
a genuine independently verified restore receipt promotes the live passive runtime to READY with zero control authority
abort_criteria: API key appears in argv or output
credential, identity, host, or governed path published

outcome.conclusion: The governed runtime first failed closed on missing restore proof, then a controlled native TrueNAS SSD-to-HDD backup and HDD-to-SSD restore round trip verified three objects against an independent SHA-256 manifest. The CI-clean live observer verified 67 effective read-only roles, performed exactly three fresh governed reads, accepted the incident-bound digest-intact receipt, and transitioned to READY with zero stale hits, zero control authority, no production deployment change, and all pools healthy.

invalidated_assumptions: a read-only method allowlist makes a root session least-privileged
bounded stale data can remain authoritative
a digest-valid receipt may name a different dataset scope
midclt command-line API keys are an acceptable credential boundary
TrueNAS Python API role collections are always lists
completed TrueNAS replication tasks always report SUCCESS
replication.run is a blocking completion call
reproduction: python -c "from truepanel.holodeck.aegis_passive_runtime import run_passive_runtime_rehearsal as run; print(run()['measurements'])"
revisit_conditions: TrueNAS API, RBAC, transport, or replication-task state semantics change
production deployment is proposed
receipt issuance or restore-test trust policy changes
experiments.strongest_follow_up: Review the field-validated passive runtime for deployment without expanding AEGIS control authority, and formalize the controlled restore-test procedure as a supported TrueNAS API/CLI runbook before broader use.
